XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Sudden shift into neutral, activation of gearbox warning light and corresponding acoustic signal
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: GROUP | HYDRAULIC | GEARBOX | ROBOTISED | ON | SWITCHED ON | SWITCHES ON | RED | RED | SYMBOL | INVOLUNTARY | NEUTRAL | SCREEN | MULTIFUNCTION | WARNS | SIGNAL | ACOUSTIC | COLD | ENGINE |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Applicability: Vehicles equipped with robotic gearboxes

  • System: Gearbox

  • Device: Automated gearbox hydraulic unit

  • Fault: Sudden shift into neutral, gearbox fault warning light comes on and warning buzzer sounds. The fault occurs more frequently when the engine is cold.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Faulty robotic gearbox hydraulic unit

• Action: Check the condition and correct functioning of the hydraulic unit of the robotised gearbox, consisting of the control unit, pump, actuators and oil reservoir. Replace if necessary.

  • Procedure:

  • Note: In the case in question, the gearbox speed sensor was initially replaced, but this did not resolve the faults. The definitive solution came with the replacement of the robotised gearbox hydraulic unit alone.
